mono-0501.d: Brutalist facade grid of wide bays, half filled in. Clean enough for the office, odd enough for the weekend.

mono-0506.d: One-point perspective corridor, frames receding deep into the distance, rays packed tight. Brutalism, but make it comfortable.

mono-0512.d: Open concentric octagons, twisting slowly inward. A study in restraint.

mono-0515.d: Topographic contour map with elevation lines packed tight. Organic lines with a scientific streak.

mono-0531.d: Sparse skyline of solid towers with grids of windows. A floor plan you can wear.

mono-0532.d: Dense concentric squares, twisting slowly inward. Shapes doing very little, very well.

mono-0572.d: Dense concentric pentagons, twisting slowly inward. Works with anything with a straight face.

mono-0592.d: Dense concentric pentagons, twisting slowly inward. The kind of print that ages well.

mono-0594.d: Dot-matrix circle on a chunky LED grid. Busy up close, calm at a distance.

mono-0595.d: Topographic contour map with elevation lines packed tight. Lines that drift and never quite settle.
